title: Title bar
purpose: The title bar is the 46px chrome band across the top of the main window. It holds the macOS window controls (leading), a drag grip, the project switcher pill (showing Home in the recordings), the per-project list tabs with a New list button, and a right-side toolbar with Split view, preview toggle and Settings. On Windows and Linux the window controls move to the trailing edge.

notes:
Merged from A (code-based) and B (measured), with the critique applied. Only the title-bar inventory was produced. The other requests in the relayed message (page creation and deploy, devbench notify, the done/remaining checklist) are outside this merge and were not acted on.

Conflicts resolved per the critique:
1. tab-hover: Errands stays focused (tree.txt:14 tone primary). A's claim that Garden is primary there is wrong; Garden is primary only in list-switch-3 (tree.txt:20).
2. List tabs: one entry, count 3. B's split into selected (1), inactive (2) and hover (1) is folded into one tab entry with states; hover is a state of Reading.
3. Traffic-light glyphs reveal on group hover (WindowControls.tsx:78-86, group-hover on MacLights). B's cmd-held attribution is dropped; the cmd-held tree matches main-default.
4. Project pill open background oklch(0.32 0.02 262 / 0.09) is not a separate open style in code (ProjectSwitcher.tsx:31-33 has only hover:bg-wash-2). It is kept as a measured observation under the open state, not as a distinct state.
5. Close, minimize, full screen, drag grip and project-row edit/delete behaviours are confirmed by code (WindowControls.tsx:139-142; TitleBar.tsx:51-56; ProjectSwitcher.tsx:76-93) and are no longer marked inferred.
6. Project-row edit and delete icons are opacity-0 until row hover, which explains why they are absent from the screenshot.
7. B's link from the project pill to context-menus is dropped. The pill opens the in-place ProjectMenu popover.
8. B's "aria label" wording is replaced by title tooltip (WindowControls.tsx:67 title attribute; ProjectSwitcher, ListTabs and TitleBar titles).
9. B's divider count of 4 is the three tab separators plus the trailing separator; kept as A's two entries.
10. A's malformed 'Icon (name check)' entry is removed; the check icon is described in the project row variant (ProjectSwitcher.tsx:62-66).

Drops (union otherwise kept):
- A's 'Icon (name check)' entry: merged into the project row.
- B's project-menu-popover region: merged into the project switcher region (same geometry).
- B's divider entry (count 4): merged into the tab separator and trailing separator entries.
- B's list tab entries (selected, inactive, hover): merged into one tab entry (count 3).
- B's cmd-held glyph claim, the open-state background as a separate state, and the pill-to-context-menus link: dropped.
- Duplicate entries and links across A and B (traffic lights, project row icons, project menu items, New project, split, preview, settings, tab click, tab right-click, delete list, New list): kept once, with both sources.
